title: Masked Symmetric Nonnegative Matrix Factorization for Community Detection in Incomplete Networks
summary: Community detection in complex networks is frequently challenged by incomplete or noisy adjacency matrices. Traditional symmetric nonnegative matrix factorization methods typically rely on zero-imputation for unobserved entries, which compromises clustering reliability. This paper proposes a Masked Symmetric Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (Masked SymNMF) framework designed to factorize partially observed networks directly.
